steps.title: Get in touch
steps.body: Tell us your date, location and what you've got in mind. No two events are the same, so there's no fixed price list — just an enquiry form that takes two minutes.

steps.title: We check and quote
steps.body: We check the date, work out what suits your guest numbers and event length, and send back a clear, tailored quote.

steps.title: Confirm your date
steps.body: Happy with the quote? We lock in your date and start planning the details — branding, menu, timings.

steps.title: We arrive and set up
steps.body: On the day, we bring the cart, the kit and the coffee. You and your guests just enjoy it.
